verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents a broad API of more than 120 actions covering domains, account settings, DNS, orders, folders, aftermarket bidding and backorders, reseller management, and delete/push operations. There is no explicit claim of full UI parity, and several UI features have no documented API coverage: SSL, email, WHOIS watchlist, and grace deletion. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage for SSL/email/watchlist/grace-deletion, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Dynadot API lets you programmatically manage domains, account settings, DNS, orders, and other account activities. Our API supports more than 120 actions
You can even delete and push domains through our API.
Use our API to engage with our aftermarket - place backorder requests, discover new auction listings, place bids, and more.
Our API functions extend to our reseller program, allowing you to manage domains under your Dynadot reseller account efficiently.
